text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A birthday present for me?! I-I don't
know what to
say!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's a lucky cat statue I got from a really
lucky
spot down south. I just hope you
don't already
have one like this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A lucky spot... down south? Add the
distinct ring
of this bell, along with the
weight...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
C-could it be? Isn't this the fabled
ultra-rare
lucky cat that only a few can
ever hope to get
their hands on?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you, thank you, thank you!
This is the
best present ever!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-hehe... I'm just glad you aren't put off
by my
present...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this? There's a scrap of
paper stuck
to the box...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Doto! You forgot to take off the receipt!
